pattern_explanation: Some of these Portuguese body-part words look similar to English words with different meanings, so learners can be misled by spelling even though the body-part meanings are shared between the languages.
false_friend_warning: The Portuguese word 'costas' looks like the English word 'costs', but it means 'back'. The Portuguese word 'pele' is easily confused with the English word 'pale', but it means 'skin'.
